title: Broken connectivity to Dana R
body:
Somewhere between https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/1d6a48d01dcd16a5767940f9e04e3003af60e713 and now (build `0105d24869-2023.08.28`) connectivity to my Dana R was broken. Currently even clicking on the bluetooth icon in the pump status does not result in reconnection. Attaching logs.
[AndroidAPS._2023-08-28_22-06-43_.342.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12458376/AndroidAPS._2023-08-28_22-06-43_.342.zip)
